title: RVE Studio: open-source strain-energy homogenisation, FE validation and design of laminated-composite cellular cores
description: RVE Studio computes the effective stiffness of laminated-composite cellular cores (honeycombs and any periodic wall network) by strain-energy homogenisation of a periodic RVE, rates the reliability of the one-dimensional wall model (bend–twist index, membrane–bending coupling, wall shear parameter), validates designs against periodic shell finite elements (built-in solver or Abaqus) with Richardson extrapolation, GCI and a mesh-convergence verdict, and generates and screens large design databases (Ashby plots, sensitivity, Pareto and robust multi-objective screening, wall buckling). Desktop application (PySide6), command line and Python API.
